title: The harness's own publications witness the storage remote
goal: CEO decision 2026-11-11 ("raise it"): the harness's submit-main, integrate and release-promote must run the storage guard too, and the susi-harness line ceiling may rise for it. The guard moves from xtask to crates/susi-harness/src/storage_guard.rs (one source; local-snapshot compiles the same file), and operator::{submit_main, integrate_pending, promote_release} call it after every live publication, so the command line and the daemon are both covered. A finding is a note beside the receipt; receipts and their digests are unchanged, and a dry run does not contact the remote for it. The susi-harness ceiling is re-pinned 37,434 -> 37,536 with the decision recorded in docs/lean-core.md.
limitations: susi-commercial-apps' own `local-workflow ship` path does not start the guard.
